specs: Nations plot in vain: an imagined ancient stone city viewed across hills at dusk; small distant groups of people gathering on roads toward it under unsettled clouds, conveying human agitation within a much wider quiet landscape. No fighting, no specific historical city.

Rulers gather against divine rule: a solemn ancient council courtyard with a few rulers seen from behind, simple unadorned circlets and plain cloaks, a low stone table, distant city walls. Pride and concerted human power suggested by posture and gathering; no villain caricatures, no map markings or written scrolls.

Casting away restraints, a metaphor of rebellion: heavy broken iron chain links and cut cords abandoned on weathered stone beneath an olive tree, distant proud city towers, an ambiguous solemn atmosphere. No prisoners, no people celebrating liberation, no shackled bodies.

Heaven's sovereignty over human pretension: vast luminous sky and high soft clouds dominate a broad landscape, a tiny distant city below. Deep calm light over the hills puts human towers in perspective. No throne in the clouds, face in sky, divine body or anthropomorphic God.

A solemn rebuke: dramatic dark rainclouds gather over an imagined ancient city and rugged hills, shafts of warm light break through, trees bend slightly in wind. Awe and moral seriousness, no lightning striking people, no casualties, flames, supernatural beings or disaster spectacle.

An appointed king on a holy hill: a dignified empty ancient stone throne on a terrace above a walled hilltop city, olive trees and morning light, the seat stable and central. Symbolic royal authority, no claim to reconstruct Zion, no figure of God or Jesus, no cross.

A royal decree of sonship: an unmarked rolled parchment with a simple clay seal rests on a stone table beside an empty wooden royal seat, warm light across the objects, a calm distant hill beyond. No visible lettering, no baby, no depiction of God or theological family portrait.

The nations and the ends of the earth: a majestic wide landscape stretching from mountain terraces across river valleys toward a far blue sea, several tiny imagined ancient settlements across different hills, expansive soft morning light. No modern geography, map, borders, flags or conquering army.

Iron scepter and shattered pottery: a plain iron rod lying diagonally beside fragments of a broken clay vessel on a stone terrace, olive leaves at the edge, hills beyond. Poetic judgment imagery rendered quietly, no person holding a weapon, no blood, injuries or violence against people.

Rulers called to wisdom: a small council of dignified ancient elders listening attentively around a low table bearing an unmarked scroll and oil lamp, sunlit stone courtyard and olive trees. Focus on teachability and sober deliberation, no divine teacher, no recognizable characters, no writing.

Reverent service and trembling joy: a few people in modest ancient earth-toned garments seen from behind, standing respectfully in a spacious open stone courtyard under a beautiful awe-inspiring sky, warm light mixed with deep cloud shadows. Worshipful rather than triumphant, no visible divine figure or statue.

A closing invitation to refuge: a welcoming open stone gateway in a strong hillside refuge, a modest traveler approaching with lowered posture, warm lamplight inside, turbulent skies clearing outside. Express yielding and finding shelter, not a literal picture of kissing a divine figure; no threats or violence.

Trouble surrounding a fugitive: one modest ancient traveler in a cloak seen from behind on a hillside path, looking toward a valley with many tiny indistinct distant figures and a city. Vulnerability and increasing pressure, no specific portrait of David or Absalom, no fight or gore.

Discouraging voices: a solitary cloaked traveler rests at the edge of an olive grove, several small indistinct people converse at a distance behind a low wall; cool shadows contrast with a little warm light around the traveler. Isolation and discouragement, no speech bubbles, writing, mocking cartoon faces or accusations depicted as fact.

Shield and lifted head: a simple ancient rounded shield leans upright beside an olive tree on a sheltered hillside, a small traveler seen from behind standing upright beyond it in warm morning light. Dignity restored and protection, no supernatural shield bubble, no divine figure.

A cry answered from the holy mountain: a small anonymous traveler with open hands stands on a rocky path facing a distant sunlit mountain, light through clouds over an imagined walled hill. Spacious distance and prayer, no literal voice rays, halo, identifiable character or supernatural body.

Sleep and waking sustained: a modest anonymous traveler rests safely on a woven mat under an olive tree at first light, folded cloak nearby, quiet hills and soft dawn beyond. Peaceful ordinary rest within an uncertain journey, no angels or magical barriers, no threat approaching the sleeper.

Courage with danger still present: an anonymous traveler stands calmly on a protected rocky rise beneath an olive tree, far away many tiny indistinct figures on surrounding valley routes. Spacious perspective and warm steady light, serious but reassuring; no active battle, portrait, injuries or triumphant conquest.

A plea to end an enemy's power to harm: a battered empty shield and broken spear lie abandoned on rocky ground as dawn light falls into a dark narrow valley; a safe open path leads away. A deliberately symbolic response to the prayer for rescue and disarming hostile power, not a literal depiction of blows or teeth. No injured people, blood, jaws, faces, skulls or divine warrior.

Rescue and blessing widen to the people: a small imagined ancient community of families gathers peacefully on a green hillside outside a welcoming stone village at morning, a broad landscape and clear light behind them. Shared care and belonging, no army victory scene, recognizable David, visible divine figure or text.
